name: Within
source:
Traverse the rancid labyrinth that is the insides of a massive dying whale as you, a grief-stricken skuba diver, wander aimlessly in search of your swallowed family.

[From [url=https://itch.io/jam/spooktober-2025/rate/3911114]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为一名悲痛欲绝的水肺潜水员，你将穿越一头垂死鲸鱼内部腐臭的迷宫，漫无目的地徘徊，寻找被吞下的家人。

[来自[url=https://itch.io/jam/spooktober-2025/rate/3911114]itch.io[/url]]
